releases.notes:
# Instant World Mirror 1.4.0 Beta

This public Beta adds the Stranded Mirror cross-save workflow, persistent-world backups, and the Heaven Mirror Superflat enchantment matrix. Both supported Minecraft versions use the same player-facing behavior.

## Stranded Mirror

- Added the Stranded Mirror for capturing named world slices and reopening them from other saves.
- Unified persistent mirror worlds and cross-save world slices in the long-term world menu.
- Added independent numbered backups for world slices and persistent mirror worlds.
- Backups preserve block entities, supported entities, distant modified chunks, item data, names, and enchantments without changing the source.
- Added one-way Minecraft 1.20.1 to 1.21.1 slice upgrades using Minecraft DataFixer validation.
- Newer slices remain blocked on 1.20.1, and missing mod content fails safely instead of silently becoming air.
- Fixed the slice-opening flow so success closes the complete menu and a rejected open keeps the selection screen usable.

## Heaven Mirror Superflat

- Added the Superflat enchantment exclusively for Heaven Mirror.
- No enchantments: creates the normal temporary copied Heaven world.
- Superflat only: creates a temporary Superflat Heaven world.
- Permanence only: retains the normal temporary copied world and existing persistent-save workflow.
- Permanence plus Superflat: retains the normal temporary copied world and adds one automatic persistent Superflat world.
- Reusing the double-enchanted mirror does not create duplicate automatic Superflat records.
- Superflat platforms use grass, two dirt layers, and bedrock.

## Persistent Worlds

- Added backup controls to the persistent list and in-world management menu.
- Persistent records retain their terrain mode and recover safely after interrupted copies.
- Generated persistent records no longer store a fake temporary-session identifier; existing records remain compatible.
- A persistent source cannot be deleted while one of its backups is still copying.

## Downloads

- `instantworldmirror-1.21.1-1.4.0-Beta.jar` - Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge, commit `002b299`
- `instantworldmirror-1.20.1-1.4.0-Beta.jar` - Minecraft 1.20.1 / Forge, commit `09fbe9c`

Delete every previous Instant World Mirror JAR before installing the file matching the Minecraft version.

## Validation

- Minecraft 1.21.1 GameTest: **54/54 passed**
- Minecraft 1.20.1 GameTest: **51/51 passed**
- Real-client menu and localization gates passed in English and Simplified Chinese on both versions.
- Full builds, JAR-content verification, configuration migration checks, and lifecycle coverage passed on both versions.
- GitHub Actions passed on both release commits.
- Team testing confirmed the Stranded Mirror and Superflat workflows without remaining issues.

## Beta limitation

- Persistent mirror records currently share eight server-wide persistent world slots. Configurable per-player quotas and expanded single-player capacity are planned separately.

releases.notes:
# Instant World Mirror 1.3.0 Beta

This public Beta advances from 1.2.2 because it adds a complete in-game administration UI and expands the persistent configuration model, in addition to regression fixes.

## Configuration UI

- Added `Options > World Mirror Settings` for server administrators.
- Added per-mirror access control: disabled, administrators only, or all players.
- Added per-mirror natural spawning, item transfer, and copy-radius settings.
- Added the global base cooldown setting.
- Saving writes the common configuration immediately and clearly indicates that a restart is required before behavior changes.
- Added complete English and Simplified Chinese UI coverage.

## Fixes

- Fixed First Dream generated loot chests losing unopened loot-table data.
- Fixed live generated block entities, including vanilla spawners, being copied without their saved state.
- Fixed mirror cooldown behavior so all three mirrors consistently use the common configuration.
- Fixed item-transfer persistence and inventory restoration across mirror exit.
- Fixed mirror copy behavior at edge chunks.
- Improved compatibility with other mods that modify the Options screen and with constructor-sensitive block entities.

## Configuration migration

- Existing common configuration files are migrated without removing valid administrator choices.
- Legacy global mirror fields are translated into the current per-mirror settings.
- Invalid old cooldown values below 30 seconds migrate to the 300-second default.
- `instantworldmirror-client.toml` remains limited to local HUD display; server behavior is controlled by `instantworldmirror-common.toml`.

## Downloads

- `instantworldmirror-1.21.1-1.3.0-Beta.jar` - Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge, commit `5d3866a`
- `instantworldmirror-1.20.1-1.3.0-Beta.jar` - Minecraft 1.20.1 / Forge, commit `a0eec17`

## Validation

- Clean builds passed for both supported Minecraft versions.
- GameTest passed 39/39 on 1.21.1 and 38/38 on 1.20.1.
- The real-client configuration UI gate passed in English and Simplified Chinese on both versions.
- Tests cover UI changes before and after restart, per-mirror behavior, item transfer, generated loot, persisted cooldown, and configuration migration.
